en.title: 5 New Historical Romances Prove the Genre Is Thriving This Fall
en.summary: Forget whispers of decline; a new wave of historical romances is set to capture readers' hearts this fall. From Gilded Age New York to Regency London, these novels offer passionate stories with diverse settings and spice levels.
en.body:
The romance reading community has been abuzz with speculation about the health of historical romance. Some fans express concern over a perceived dip in new releases, with even beloved authors exploring other subgenres. However, the notion that historical romance is dead is a narrative that is simply not holding up. This fall, a vibrant collection of novels is emerging, not only continuing the tradition but also demonstrating how historical fiction itself is becoming increasingly romantic and sensual.

This curated list aims to showcase the genre's vitality, featuring books published or releasing in September and October. The selections span continents and centuries, from the opulence of Gilded Age New York to the refined ballrooms of Regency London and the intricate court life of Ming Dynasty China. What unites them is a promise of compelling narratives, well-developed characters, and, crucially, a happy ending for devoted readers. The spice levels vary, catering to a broad spectrum of preferences, from closed-door tenderness to undeniably steamy encounters, all proving that historical romance is far from over.

## Fall's Most Anticipated Historical Romances

Among the standout titles is **Lisa Kleypas**'s latest offering, **Queen of Lombard Street**, releasing this October. While it leans more towards historical fiction with its substantial page count and intricate plotlines involving multiple characters, it doesn't shy away from the "red-hot romance" Kleypas is celebrated for. The story is set in Victorian England and centers on Reina, a brilliant economist driven by her ambition to establish a bank exclusively for women. Her quest for financial independence for her gender takes a dramatic turn when her mentor is implicated in fraud. To navigate this crisis, an undercover police detective named John infiltrates her circle by posing as a butler, setting the stage for intrigue and undeniable chemistry.

This book exemplifies how established authors are pushing the boundaries of the genre, blending meticulous historical research with the passionate, character-driven romance that fans adore. It’s a testament to the enduring power of well-crafted historical narratives that resonate with modern audiences seeking both escapism and meaningful connection.

## Why This Matters to Fans

For avid readers who cherish the unique blend of historical detail and swoon-worthy romance, this influx of new titles is a cause for celebration. It signals that publishers and authors are continuing to invest in the genre, recognizing its dedicated fanbase and its potential for fresh storytelling. The resurgence isn't just about quantity; it's about the quality and diversity of the stories being told. Readers are looking for complex heroines, compelling historical backdrops, and relationships that feel earned and passionate. The fact that these novels are hitting shelves in a variety of settings and with varied heat levels ensures that there's something for every historical romance enthusiast, reaffirming the genre's place in the literary landscape.

## What's Next

As September and October unfold, readers can eagerly anticipate diving into these promising new releases. The continued success of these novels will undoubtedly influence future publishing trends, potentially encouraging more publishers to explore the rich tapestry of history for romantic storytelling. Keep an eye on these titles as they arrive, promising to reignite passion for historical romance.

content_raw: There’s definitely a vibe among romance readers that historical romance is in a downturn. Some might even say historical romance is dead . I will admit, it seems like there are fewer and fewer historical romance novels coming out over the last few years. And some of my favorite historical authors are migrating to other subgenres. But I fully reject the notion that historical romance is dead. There are still wonderful historical romance novels coming out every month. Furthermore, I’ve noticed historical fiction becoming more romantic (and more sexy) than it’s ever been before. I would never recommend a story here without a happy ending. But I have rounded up a mix of historical romance novels with a few deeply romantic historical fiction novels for this list. The settings and time periods range from Gilded Age New York to Regency London to Ming Dynasty China. And the spice levels range from closed door to so hot I’m blushing just thinking about them. But all of them were published or will be published in September and October of this year. And all of them, also, prove that historical romance still lives! New Historical Romance: Fall 2026 Queen of Lombard Street by Lisa Kleypas The queen of historical romance is back with a new book out this October. It skews more towards historical fiction, with a longer page count, more attention to side characters, and multiple plots. But it still has the red-hot romance that Lisa Kleypas is famous for among romance readers. Set in Victorian England, Reina is a brilliant female economist with a single-minded goal to open a bank just for women so female customers can own their own bank accounts. But when her mentor and financial backer is suspected of fraud, John, an undercover police detective, pretends to be a butler and applies for a job among her recently hired, and delightful, formerly-imprisoned staff. Caroline loves working with her father as a rare books expert. She expects to continue working after marrying NYC’s most eligible bachelor, Orson. But the moment the wedding vows are uttered, Orson transforms from prince charming into a cruel, violent jailor, with the legal right to stop her from working or leaving the unhappy marriage. Caroline jumps at the chance to catalogue the private library of Zane, a reclusive and disfigured billionaire. Zane will do anything to protect Caroline and help her gain her freedom, but the pathway there isn’t so easy. This book is beautiful to read, but check the trigger warnings for domestic violence if that is a sensitive subject for you.
